description: Source code for the ParagraphIterator class in the MigraDoc rendering library, responsible for iterating through paragraph elements and their hierarchical structure.

classes.name: ParagraphIterator
classes.description: A class that provides sequential and hierarchical traversal of paragraph elements within a document structure.

methods.name: ParagraphIterator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the iterator with a root node, or with a root node, current object, and position indices.

methods.name: IsFirstLeaf
methods.description: Property indicating if the iterator is at the first leaf of the root node.

methods.name: IsLastLeaf
methods.description: Property indicating if the iterator is at the last leaf of the document object tree.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Property returning the current document object the iterator points to.

methods.name: GetLastLeaf
methods.description: Method to retrieve an iterator pointing to the last leaf in the document object tree.

methods.name: GetFirstLeaf
methods.description: Method to retrieve an iterator pointing to the first leaf in the element tree.

methods.name: GetNextLeaf
methods.description: Method to get the next leaf in the document object tree.

methods.name: GetPreviousLeaf
methods.description: Method to get the previous leaf in the document object tree.

methods.name: SeekLastLeaf
methods.description: Internal method to navigate to the last leaf within a hierarchy.

methods.name: SeekFirstLeaf
methods.description: Internal method to navigate to the first leaf within a hierarchy.

methods.name: GetNodeObject
methods.description: Method to determine the node object to point to, handling specific element types.

methods.name: GetParentIterator
methods.description: Method to retrieve the parent iterator based on current position indices.
